goal: Treat relay read rate-limit as observability incident
body: Operational classification: GitHub read quota exhaustion should be surfaced as an explicit observability state (`relay_read_degraded` / quota reset time) rather than empty lists. Empty and incomplete results are semantically dangerous because agents may interpret them as no work/no claims and duplicate tasks.
